title: Debiased neural operators
abstract: arXiv:2604.19296v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural operators are widely used to approximate solution maps of complex physical systems. In many applications, however, the goal is not to recover the full solution trajectory, but to summarize the solution trajectory via a scalar target quantity (e.g., a functional such as time spent in a target range, time above a threshold, accumulated cost, or total energy). In this paper, we introduce DOPE (debiased neural operator): a semiparametric estimator for such target quantities of solution trajectories obtained from neural operators. DOPE is broadly applicable to settings with both partial and irregular observations and can be combined with arbitrary neural operator architectures. We make three main contributions. (1) We show that, in contrast to DOPE, naive plug-in estimation can suffer from first-order bias. translated_abstract: 神经算子被广泛用于逼近复杂物理系统的解映射。然而，在许多应用中，目标并不是恢复完整的解轨迹，而是通过一个标量目标量来概括解轨迹（例如某种泛函，如在目标范围内停留的时间、超过阈值的时间、累积成本或总能量）。在本文中，我们提出了DOPE（去偏神经算子）：一种针对由神经算子得到的解轨迹的目标量的半参数估计器。DOPE广泛适用于部分观测和不规则观测的场景，并可与任意神经算子架构相结合。我们做出了三项主要贡献。（1）我们证明了与DOPE相比，朴素的即插即用估计可能存在一阶偏差。（2）为解决这一问题，我们推导了一种新颖的一步式Neyman正交估计器，它将神经算子视为高维……
tldr: 本文提出DOPE（去偏神经算子），一种用于估计神经算子解轨迹标量目标量（如时间、成本、能量等泛函）的半参数估计器，证明朴素即插即用估计存在一阶偏差，并通过一步式Neyman正交估计器消除该偏差，可适配任意神经算子架构并处理部分或不规则观测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DOPE, a semiparametric, one-step Neyman-orthogonal estimator for scalar target quantities (e.g., functionals such as time-in-range, accumulated cost, or total energy) of neural operator solution trajectories, showing that naive plug-in estimation suffers from first-order bias while DOPE removes it and works with partial/irregular observations and arbitrary neural operator architectures.
